summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, reporting movements in authorized and issued share capital for August 2026. The filing shows issuance of 710,000,000 ordinary shares, increasing total issued shares to 19,884,988,918, with no treasury shares or change in authorized capital. It is a routine regulatory disclosure under HKEX Listing Rules, not a special-situation event. No strategic transaction, tender offer, or restructuring is involved; the change likely reflects equity incentive exercises or other ordinary issuances. Watch for any subsequent capital-markets activity, but no risk-arb angle applies.
